The '''Tihaz Theatre''' was located in [[Ariana]], [[Garos IV]], and was situated near the planet's [[Imperial Headquarters (Garos IV)|Imperial Headquarters]] and [[Chado's Pub]]. [[Jaalib Brandl]] performed there in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="BYK" />
